name: path-ahead-checks
description: Dev-only checks for the browser build. The app itself has no dependencies and no build step.

scripts.//comment: check:fast is everything that does not need jsdom. It runs in about a second and catches most regressions; check:ui is still the one that proves the controls are wired up.
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:boot && npm run check:golden && npm run check:filters && npm run check:flows && npm run check:site
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:fast && npm run check:ui
